title: How can Tony Romo accept "full responsibility" in a statement from an unnamed spokesperson?

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: How can Tony Romo accept "full responsibility" in a statement from an unnamed spokesperson?
sources.description: Confusion was the first reaction to the TMZ item in which former Cowboys quarterback and CBS broadcaster Tony Romo accepted "full responsibility" for his recent OWI arrest in Milwaukee, in a statement issued by an unnamed spokesperson.
